v.t: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Neh 9:29 (11 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Deut 30:14 (46 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Isa 28:16 (60 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Joel 2:32 (103 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Isa 52:7 (71 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Deut 32:21 (28 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
